verdict.rationale: Secureframe has embedded AI features (Comply AI), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers, which makes the axis applicable. The evidence only documents Secureframe acting as an MCP server that external clients like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here, and nothing shows Secureframe itself plugging in third-party MCP servers or using their tools.
